title: Individual feedback, dated packets and teacher-only delivery

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Read outbox before and after generation so eligible previously verified new documents can be delivered despite independent generation holds.
Current teacher-only email instructions override the older mandatory Hub Print direction; recipient and sender resolve to the one explicitly authorized school address, with no CC/BCC.
Preserve the pinned approved adapter/runtime and deployed outbox contract; never forge authentication, replace baseline or force configuration checks to pass.
Reuse verified unchanged drafts/PDFs without another model call; interrupted model/save response requires exact readback and no blind retry or rebilling.
Critical-aspect and science-writing reports stay separate. Attributed evidence, actual review chronology and current approved formats govern; not-assessed is not Beginning.
Missing-work contracts require complete fresh coverage and current roster/flags/due dates; exclude Exempt, unassigned, newly joined, future-due and verified extended work.
Individual private filing and content/destination/index verification precede Made; Made this run requires a newly saved exact report revision.
Daily packet uses actual Eastern saved-feedback date, entire PDF readback and manifest. Include current student report types; exclude teacher reports and only proven duplicate representations.
Before send, verify immutable PDF/manifest and current expiry, durably record intent and obtain the first successful send_allowed_once claim for the exact batch.
One claim allows one Gmail send only. Confirm with actual SENT/raw MIME, exact sender/recipient/subject/attachment hash and private claim token; any uncertainty stops sending and holds the batch.
Drain at most ten newly eligible batches; packet expansion sends only new contributions. Never use Printed/Handed marks as deduplication or delivery evidence.

Resolve current deployed deterministic missing-work-zero and two-week submission-window policy; eligible automatic zeros and later higher-only replacements require its complete-coverage, original-event and exclusion gates.

Never choose the eligibility-window anchor from discovery or modified dates. If authoritative policy or coverage is unavailable, hold dependent zero/replacement decisions; exact Photosynthesis empty intake still waits.

success_checks: Every Made report has exact saved private file, content/source/date/index readback; new counts exclude reused historical reports.
Dated all-class PDF has verified full content, source manifest, page order and private destination; teacher analyses remain separate.
Each reported sent batch has the exact native Gmail SENT/raw-MIME and canonical outbox confirmed receipt; reserved/uncertain is not sent.
Printed and Handed-out marks, teaching-plan notes and historical checklist groups are unchanged; email is not physical delivery.
After confirmed email direct the teacher to its attachment; give Hub recovery controls only on a real delivery failure or request.
